ModMetaData.name: The Dead Man's Switch - Legion
ModMetaData.description:
一支新的殖民舰队前锋到达了边缘世界，并展开了新一代作战体系部署。他们带来了全新的机兵、装备、载具，以及——全新的空中支援体系。

本MOD是对失能机关本体及其部分附属的综合拓展，包括：

22个全新机兵
包含15种中型与5种超重型型号。各单位承担不同战术角色，从后勤支持到正面压制均有覆盖，可形成结构完整的军团体系。超重型机兵需要加载The Dead Man's Switch - AncientCorps。

新叙事者：艾丽萨
来自武装殖民舰队的军官。她以临机决断推动局势发展，事件节奏偏随机，但更倾向于舰队相关互动与直接威胁。
在她看来，机兵部队是舰队体系的延伸。维持并扩充机兵编制，更容易获得她的认可。

空中支援系统
全新的空中支援系统——与武装殖民舰队成为盟友，在通讯台呼叫多种空中支援争取优势甚至扭转战局。如果权限足够，甚至能调用武装殖民舰队的核打击系统.......
但是当心，您的部分敌人也将有呼叫空中支援的手段......

一款全新载具
“灰骑士”——重型通用底盘，支持更换不同的炮塔来达到特定的效果。需要加载The Dead Man's Switch - Motorized。

除此之外，还增添了两套全新衣物、两个拥有特殊功能的装备以及五款全新武器。

总策划/美工/XML：Silver
主程序：星羽枝繁
封面/叙事者：数据删除
CE:白金trigger


A new vanguard force of the Colonial Fleet has arrived in the Rim, deploying a next-generation combat system. They bring brand-new mech units, equipment, vehicles, and most importantly - a brand-new aerial support system.

This mod is a comprehensive expansion for The Dead Man's Switch core and several of its addons, including:

22 brand-new mech units
Includes 15 medium models and 5 ultra-heavy models. Each unit fills a different tactical role, from logistical support to frontline suppression, forming a complete and structured legion combat system. Ultra-heavy mechs require The Dead Man's Switch - AncientCorps.

New storyteller: Elisa
An officer from the Armed Colonial Fleet. She drives the situation forward through tactical judgment. Her pacing is somewhat random, but she favors fleet-related interactions and direct threats.
In her view, mech forces are an extension of the Fleet system. Maintaining and expanding your mech roster will earn her approval more easily.

Aerial support system
A brand-new aerial support system - become allies with the Armed Colonial Fleet and call in multiple types of aerial support via the comms console to gain an advantage or even turn the tide of battle. With sufficient authorization, you can even request access to the Armed Colonial Fleet's nuclear strike system.......
But be careful: some of your enemies can also call aerial support......

A brand-new vehicle
"Gray Knight" - a heavy universal chassis that supports turret swapping for different tactical effects. Requires The Dead Man's Switch - Motorized.

In addition, this mod also adds two new apparel sets, two special-function pieces of gear, and five new weapons.
